dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: How's things going? Sitting pretty?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whoa, that was sudden!

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, terribly sorry. That wasn't my intention to scare you.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: I'm Kabayama, and I often sit in the spot where you're sitting now. It's a nice, quiet place where you can just think about life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like it back?

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: Thanks, but it's alright. By the way, you're not from here, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: Then you must be quite knowledgeable indeed. I've never seen the outside world, though I've had a lot of experience moving house.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: *sigh* Speaking of that...

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: We moved so often when I was young that I never really had the chance to make good friends. I saw many a fine sight while wandering about, but there was no one to share them with...

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: You know what? Why don't I show those places to you? If you pass by spots like this, take a seat and have a look about — then come back and tell me what you think.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: One such place is beneath a stone gate at the highest point in The Narrows. One of them is an open space surrounded by corals near the Evernight Temple, and the last one is beside the towering ruins at the Serpent's Heart.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: I've left markings on all these places, and hung a lamp there to light my way. You should find them, easy-peasy.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: You're back.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: You've found all the places? ...Well, perhaps they're not much to look at for someone as well-traveled as you.

choices.text: Well, I thought that they looked quite unique.

response.speaker: Kabayama
response.text: Ah, what a shame that I never managed to share them with anyone else. Still, I'm glad to just have your opinion.

response.speaker: Kabayama
response.text: Perhaps there are many places more impressive than these. I mean, it is just dark down here, and there really isn't much variety in terms of food either. And we need to beware of the vishaps...

response.speaker: Kabayama
response.text: But now that I've lived here for so long, I feel attached to this place, you know? And I still miss those few spots of mine.

response.speaker: Kabayama
response.text: Do you ever feel the same way? Even a place like this can be called home once you've stayed long enough.

response.speaker: Kabayama
response.text: Well, thanks for hearing me out, in any case. I don't have much to give you in return, really, but please take these.

choices.text: They were pretty run-of-the-mill. I've seen more impressive sights.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: You're back.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: Haven't found all the places yet? Oh, that's a crying shame.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: Let me go over the locations again.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: One such place is beneath a stone gate at the highest point in The Narrows. One of them is an open space surrounded by corals near the Evernight Temple, and the last one is beside the towering ruins at the Serpent's Heart.

dialogues.speaker: Kabayama
dialogues.text: I've left markings on all these places, and hung a lamp there to light my way. You should find them, easy-peasy.
